native_retrieval.snippet: * 2 Council of Ministers (28 December 2013 - 14 February 2014)). Cabinet of the Delhi Legislative Assembly. | Head of government | Arvind Kejriwal |. The **First Kejriwal cabinet** was the Council of Ministers in fifth Delhi Legislative Assembly headed by Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal.*[citation needed*]. Kejriwal was then sworn in as 7th Chief Minister of Delhi on 28 December, leading the First Kejriwal cabinet, the youngest cabinet in Delhi ever. Dhir was elected as the speaker of the legislative assembly on 3 January 2014. After 49 days, Kejriwal resigned as a chief minister following the failure of the introduction of Delhi's Jan Lokpal Bill in the assembly on 14 February 2014. | Chief Minister | Arvind Kejriwal | 28 December 2013 | 14 February 2014 |  | AAP |.
